profile.headline: Computer Graphics R&D
profile.summary:
Computer Graphics and Animation software R&D

Specialties: Geometry, procedural systems, FX programming, shaders, solving interesting problems in computer graphics.

positions.title: Graphics Programmer
positions.description:
Design and develop run time systems and animation tools for the Uncharted and other PS3 video games.
I have been involved in most aspects of the game production from design to modeling, animation to programming and rendering. 

Maya tools for content creation. Developed the referencing and level editing tools. The system includes a novel method to edit modifiers per instance. Created a myriad of modeling, rigging (character, facial, wrinkle maps, hair), texturing tools and scripts in Maya. Research to convert blend shapes to bone animation.

Run time systems
Developed the entire water system to render any type of water surface (ponds, rivers and lakes).
This includes research and creation of the water flow shader and displacement methods. The system includes all systems from artist tools, to run-time and game-play systems, coding (not all optimizations) to SPUs and rendering. It includes all rendering aspects of the characters interacting with the water (ripples and getting wet).

Developed the ocean technology for Uncharted 3. Research and development of the irregular clipmaps and a hierarchical wave system (using a combination of wave-particles, gerstner and parametric waves). Integrated the water and game-play systems to allow whole levels (boats), characters and physics objects to be driven by the waves. Coordinated other programmers, effects artists and designers the two main levels where the water would drive all the level geometry of the game. This includes the 2011 E3 Sony demo.

Developed the majority of the shader code base for Uncharted 2 and co-architect of the shading system for Uncharted 3.  Designer of environment and special effects shaders for water, snow, particles, skies and special effects for background and character objects.

Almost daily I constantly collaborate with programmers, IT, and artists. My goal has always been to find ways to improve the graphics quality of the game by creating innovative methods and tools.

positions.title: Reviewer
positions.description: Reviewer for ACM Transactions on Graphics Journal and SIGGRAPH conference

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Research & Developed numerous tools for modeling, physical simulation, controllable dynamics, rigging, animation, lighting, and look development. Most development using Maya.

Designed and implemented studio's subdivision surface pipeline. Used in all Disney's digial productions. The pipeline encompasses multiple departments: modeling, rigging, lookdev, and rendering.

Gemini R&D Project. Researched and developed tools to produce photo-realistic facial animation using motion capture data.
In particular created a program to transfer expression blend shapes across vastly different character models.

Movie Credits: Treasure Planet, Reign of Fire, Chicken Little

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Software Lead for the movie "Cast Away".

Responsible for new software development between production and software group. Develop multiple plugins for water simulation and compositing. Most plugins were developed for the Houdini animation package.
 
Extended the studio's lighting tool.

Films: "Stuart Little", "Hollow Man", "Cast Away"

organizations.name: SIGGRAPH
organizations.description: Unified Jury. Review of all content for the research, interactive, studio and production (film and games) talks.
